title: 동탄 긴급 속보
caption: 속보입니다. 동탄 일대에서 원인을 알 수 없는 집단 공격이…
prompt: TV breaking news anchor beside a red outbreak map in a dim living room, ominous.

title: 소리에 반응하는 감염자
caption: 출입문 종소리에 고개를 돌리고 달린다.
prompt: Monochrome security CCTV view of a convenience-store customer suddenly leaning forward to sprint; grounded grainy security camera look.

title: 큰 소리를 내지 마십시오
caption: 긴급재난문자: 큰 소리를 내지 마십시오.
prompt: Close-up of a smartphone receiving a Korean emergency warning; through a balcony view below many dark running silhouettes.

title: 아빠의 빈 해열제
caption: 엄마: 아빠 약만 구해서 바로 오자.
prompt: Shelter living room: closed bedroom door, thermometer reading 39.4 and empty medicine box on table; worried Lily and Jin with small Luna prepare to leave, father unseen.

title: 라크몽 약국에서 약 확보
caption: 엄마: 찾았다. 이제 집에 가자.
prompt: In dim pharmacy Lily places two fever medicine boxes into crossbody bag; Jin and small Luna beside her; half-lowered shutter behind them.

title: 입간판의 굉음
caption: 진: …어.
prompt: Outside pharmacy a gust topples a large white orange-bordered A-frame sign onto paving; Lily, Jin and Luna freeze.

title: 고개를 돌리는 무리
caption: 소리에 맞춰 일제히 질주한다.
prompt: On lakeside walkway several grey zombies snap heads toward the fallen sign then lean forward to sprint; no wounds.

title: 경사로 아래도 막혔다
caption: 진: 엄마, 아래도 있어….
prompt: Lily carrying Luna runs with Jin then stops at top of descending ramp, another zombie group climbing from below, lake visible beyond.
visualNote: 이동 동선 컷: 경사로의 좀비 무리는 장면 설명 기준.

title: 앞뒤로 포위
caption: 화단과 벽 사이로 몰리는 세 식구.
prompt: Overhead wide of Lily, Jin and small Luna trapped between planter and wall, two zombie groups approaching from opposite ends.

title: 엄마의 휴대폰 미끼
caption: 엄마: 잘 가라, 내 폰.
prompt: Lily holds Luna and throws her ringing phone toward distant metal bench; one horde turns toward bench, lower ramp horde still advances.
visualNote: 알람 준비 동작: 던지기와 좀비 유인은 장면 설명 기준.

title: 뭐가 나와도 꼭 써야 돼
caption: 엄마: 서진아, 뭐가 나와도 그거 꼭 써야 돼.
prompt: Lily blocks ramp entrance with fallen large sign, kneels at Jins eye level and reassures him; Luna on Jins lap behind barrier.
visualNote: 모자 대화 중심: 입간판으로 버티는 동작은 장면 설명 기준.

title: 시계에서 튀어나온 크레이지 슬롯
caption: 삐에로: 짜잔! 불렀어요, 꼬마 손님?
prompt: Macro of Jin pressing red nose on LEFT wrist purple jester watch; physical purple ivory clown head emerges and grows beside wrist, mouth slot spinning; watch stays on wrist.

title: 7번이 나왔다
caption: 진: 칠… 칠…!
prompt: Close-up clown mouth slot locked on glowing 7, shocked delighted Jin reflected beside it; mother takes small Luna into arms. Jin still in normal clothes in THIS panel only.

title: 서진이의 슈트 변신
caption: 진: 엄마! 진짜 나왔어!
prompt: Red gold plates assemble onto little Jins body, face uncovered, four mechanical gold spider legs unfurl from green backpack; Lily holding Luna amazed.

title: 사용설명서는 없어요
caption: 엄마: 엄마 옆에서, 같이 하는 거야.
prompt: Jin joyfully looks at his armored hands; Lily with Luna braces shaking A-frame barrier with shoulder, zombies behind it.

title: 첫 거미줄은 실패
caption: 진: 으악!
prompt: Jin accidentally tangles himself in silver web; Lily calmly opens his clenched hand and coaches him; humor and fear, same child suit.

title: 손바닥 펴고, 천천히
caption: 엄마: 손바닥 펴고. 천천히.
prompt: Jin aims OPEN palm down toward distant deck lamp, long straight web fires; he excitedly points out a zipline route, Lily holding Luna beside him.

title: 경사로 거미줄 그물
caption: 진: 그물 발사!
prompt: Broad sticky silver web NET stretched across both ramp railings catches approaching grey zombies as sign collapses; Jin and Lily above it.

title: 엄마·루나와 줄타기
caption: 진: 엄마, 꽉 잡아!
prompt: Wide dramatic overhead zipline: armored Jin slides toward lakeside lamp carrying Lily at waist with mechanical legs, Luna supported at torso within mothers arms, zombie crowd safely below.
visualNote: 가족 줄타기 동작 중심: 아래의 좀비 무리는 장면 설명 기준.

title: 엄마의 신호, 왼쪽!
caption: 엄마: 서진아, 왼쪽!
prompt: Dynamic midair dodge near deck: Jin braces a spare mechanical leg against side railing to swing family left, lone zombie leaps and misses; all four mechanical legs remain connected to green backpack.
visualNote: 착지 동작 참고: 좀비를 피해 왼쪽으로 트는 액션은 장면 설명 기준.

title: 착지와 슈트 회수
caption: 삐에로: 7번, 사용 완료!
prompt: On dry lakeside wooden deck after landing, suit dissolves into tiny metal spiders returning to LEFT wrist watch; Jin reappears in yellow shirt and beige shorts, mother sets Luna down.

title: 약도 무사해
caption: 엄마: 아빠 약도 무사해.
prompt: Warm hug on deck, Lily checks two medicine boxes in bag and hugs Jin, small Luna presses against them; watch glows green.

title: 집으로 가는 길의 새 무리
caption: 진: 한 번 더 해도 돼?
prompt: Purple dusk wide shot, only path around lake toward home blocked by larger group of zombie silhouettes; Lily, normal-clothes Jin, small Luna in foreground.

title: 두 번째 룰렛, 암전
caption: 엄마: 아빠한테 가야지. / 삐에로: 과연~ 몇 번일까요?
prompt: Close dramatic Jin pressing watch and grown jester spinning mouth reel for second draw, numbers motion blurred and UNREADABLE, Lily shields Jin, zombies turn; bright purple glow with edges fading black, cliffhanger NO outcome.
visualNote: 룰렛 재소환 중심: 달려드는 무리와 마지막 암전은 장면 설명 기준.
